_doc: Round-9 paired final exam (PREREG-ROUND9.md): the one source of seeds, arms, caps and flags for run_exam9_wave.sh, run_exam9_chain.sh, check_exam9_wave.py, score_exam9.py, broker_watchdog.sh, launch_gate9.sh, launch_smoke9.sh, fidelity9.py, seed_audit9.py and make_exam9_freeze.sh (which also writes exam9-seeds.json from it). Part of the freeze list; do not edit after the freeze. Wave names: exam waves 1-4 (batch exam9-w<wave>-<arm>); a voided wave re-run <wave>r<k> (e.g. 1r2 -> exam9-w1r2-<arm>; the latest re-run replaces the voided wave everywhere); the make-up wave m1 (batch exam9-m1-<arm>) and, if a make-up wave itself is voided, its re-run m1r<k> (exam9-m1r<k>-<arm>); gate[-r<k>] (gate9-new[-r<k>]); smoke[-r<k>] (smoke9-<arm>[-r<k>]). The prereg is frozen as a copy (prereg_frozen, written by make_exam9_freeze.sh); after the freeze PREREG-ROUND9.md may only grow at its end (revision section), which run_exam9_wave.sh and check_exam9_wave.py verify byte for byte.

butcher_probe._doc: PREREG-ROUND9.md section 2: the original tick-0 probe (the script that produced run1.json; bench/butcher_probe.py is a later copy with a header and another save directory) and its results; make_exam9_freeze.sh copies them from source into <root>/seed-audit/ and checks these shas.

replacements._doc: PREREG-ROUND9.md section 2: used only before the freeze, for a seed that fails the quest check or the audit (none did: Butcher 16/16 by the tick-0 wounded-townsman probe, King 16/16 by manual_seed_has_king). King: the next King-quest seeds after 4150098 (quest_lottery.py = bridge manual_seed_has_king).

gate._doc: PREREG-ROUND9.md section 6. Rule b: a cycle signature (exam9_lib.cycle_signature: '<status>:<kinds>', kinds = the chosen-option kinds filling >= 10 of the last 40 decisions, or every kind of the last 4 decisions for no_progress_4) not in known_cycles (the round-8 signatures, written out literally here). Rule e (queue model): per finished gate game, mean think T (all games' think_seconds pooled), its own time per decision own = max(0, seconds/decisions - mean alive games during its run x T); projected minutes = decisions x (concurrency x T + own) / 60; pause when the largest projection > wall_fraction x minutes.

fidelity._doc: PREREG-ROUND9.md sections 5 and 8: old_n round-8 held-out prompts with d9facts3 (argmax = logged choice), each scored repeat times (argmax identical); new_n relabel-d13bf5 test rows with d13facts5 (round 9d since 2026-09-24 09:1x; round 9b: the new arm was d11facts5 with facts version 5; it was d10facts4 / relabel-d10f4 until the owner's retrain decision of 2026-09-23 21:40), scored repeat times; post_n_per_arm exam decisions per arm after the exam, stratified by game.
